positionDefinition: 官方資料 numbers 陣列為升冪排序；position 1-5 指排序位置，不代表實際搖出先後順序。
lagDefinition: lag 1 指下一個開獎期，不保證是下一個日曆日；lag 2-5 依序為後續第 2-5 個開獎期。

validation.method: Expanding walk-forward. For each test draw, rank candidates from position-specific trigger-number to next-draw co-occurrence counts using only pairs available before the prediction. Top 5; exclude previous draw's trigger numbers.
